svg.title: agentd - AWS architecture (staging, ap-northeast-1) - verified against the live account 2026-09-08

g.text: agentd - AWS architecture (staging, ap-northeast-1) - verified against the live account 2026-09-08
VPC 10.0.0.0/16 - NO NAT - NO private subnets
(no NAT, so in-VPC would have no route to S3)
Blue = inside the VPC (every subnet is public).
Pink = serverless, deliberately outside the VPC.
Sand = data + secrets. Lilac = edge/DNS/CDN. Grey = observability.
Dashed arrows = config, images, logs, brokered calls.
